title: Quantum Depletion and Momentum Distribution in the Dilute Hard-Sphere Bose Gas
main_claim: For 3D hard spheres at zero temperature, with the thermodynamic limit taken at fixed density before the dilute limit, the nonzero-momentum occupation measure rescaled by sqrt(8 pi rho a) and divided by N sqrt(rho a^3) converges weakly to the Bogoliubov measure of mass 8/(3 sqrt pi). This holds uniformly over all pure and mixed ground states, so the depletion is (8/(3 sqrt pi)) sqrt(rho a^3) + o(sqrt(rho a^3)).

issues.location: sections/local-palm.tex, proof of Proposition palm:augmented-comparison (exponent conditions)
issues.description: The third (omission) term costs D^{4x} (relative-count factors) times E M_w <= C D^{-1-1/8+x} (Lemma palm:omissions, d-cell good-neighborhood loss), which is D^{-1-1/8+5x}. Getting this below D^{-1-u/8} needs 5x+u/8<1/8, but the stated condition is 4x+u/8<1/8. This is harmless: the other stated condition x<u/24 together with u small already implies 5x+u/8<1/8. It is a bookkeeping slip, not a gap.

coverage: Read in full: introduction, setup, energy-consequences (four energy outputs, observable lemma, local covariance proof, projection occupations), assembly (far-pairs variance lemma, RMS interpolation, infrared estimate, decomposition into four nonnegative parts) and momentum (translation identity, shift-averaging lemma, Neumann-diagonal computation, Riemann sums, change of units, tightness, mixed states). Read most of local-palm (reference measure, counts, omissions, two-copy transport, cancellation of the normalizer, switch expansion, fourth-moment bookkeeping, scalar transfer inequality) and the statement plus closing part of long-palm (augmented moments, Hellinger projection, exponent choice x<w/12). Skimmed the start of energy.tex (BBCOS upper bound, FJGMOT replacement, parameter choices, rough bound). Not checked line by line: local-paths, routes (the BPP/Timar route construction), the middle of long-palm, and most of energy.tex. Results imported from FJGMOT, BBCOS and the companion paper [H] were taken on trust. Checked numerically or by hand: the mass of nu_Bog is 8/(3 sqrt pi) (mpmath, matches to 30 digits); the integral of F_alpha over (2 pi)^3 is (8/(3 sqrt pi)) alpha^{3/2}, including the 1D integral sqrt2/3; sigma_0 matches the pushforward of F_{alpha_0}; D_*=alpha_0^{3/2}/sqrt(eta) and alpha_k -> alpha_0; the normalisation 1/(D sqrt eta)*(1/V)=1/(N sqrt eta); the Neumann cosine translation diagonal equals cos(p_i h_i); the octant-to-R^3 Fourier factor; the Cauchy-Schwarz bound b+2 sqrt(ab); the shift-separation count (H+2R)/B; the Fourier multiplier lower bound in the far-pairs lemma; the RMS interpolation and sqrt-comparison constants 1 and 8; Hölder along d-cell paths giving the R^6 factor with 6w<u/8; the CCR transpose identity; the real/imaginary positive-part decomposition with the factor-4 loss; and the exponent bookkeeping in palm:counts, palm:fourth and long:comparison.
